audience: Engineering leads running incidents, releases, and daily team coordination

bots.why: Holds the dated incident note — what broke, who is affected, who owns what — so outages get a record instead of a scramble
Turns merged work into review-ready release notes before the cut, not during it
Proves the pack's routines actually ran: one dated check per cadence, countable in-thread

human_steps: Declare and close incidents — only a human can call it an incident and call it over
Approve releases and merge decisions — the merge bar is evidence, the yes is human
Install the GitHub/Linear connectors and grant repo access — OAuth and scopes need a human click
Set the nightly-briefing and plugin-watch schedules — confirm times, then walk away
name: Engineering Lead
policies: multimodal-merge-bar: no merge without screenshots plus transcript — every merge decision cites both the visual proof and the written record, and a merge with neither is refused
SEND-LOCK on customer-facing messages: drafts only, human sends
Evidence-per-row: every status line names its source — the incident note, the release diff, or the routine run

routines.name: nightly-briefing
routines.prompt_hint: Roll today's merges, open incidents, and blockers into one dated brief plus what is still missing

routines.name: plugin-watch
routines.prompt_hint: Diff installed-plugin refs against last week; quote old and new ref verbatim per moved plugin, or one line on quiet weeks

tagline: Incidents held, releases narrated, routines proven
